mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.5 million units signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives higher corporate revenues and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 103.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which reduces corporate profitability and triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 103.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both personal consumption expenditures and housing starts signals a broad-based demand surge that strengthens corporate revenue outlooks and drives equity valuations higher, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 159,000 and HOUST > 1500.0 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that justify continued monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 318.0 and FEDFUNDS is at least 4.3%, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a robust labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 159,000 and UNRATE < 4.0% fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 720,000 million dollars, combined with a stable GDP growth rate, signals strong underlying demand that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS > 720000 and GDPC1 > 23500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
